traces.bed_board_specialty_orders_audit: Use the CWC Encounter tenant/security context and stable Business View UUIDs for the Encounter, Person, and Order entities, preserving an **order-level grain** (one qualifying specialty order per encounter/FIN) while joining ENCOUNTER, PERSON, and ORDERS through validated keys. Resolve specialty categories and order/status filters through governed Millennium Code Sets—not hard-coded display text—and enforce mandatory guardrails for tenant/organization scope, authorized PHI access, encounter/date bounds, active or clinically relevant order statuses, null-safe joins, duplicate prevention, and validation against a known-safe row-count baseline.
traces.rehab_pt_ot_slp_therapy_minutes_extract:
Use the governed CWC Encounter tenant/security context and Business View UUIDs, with encounter-level grain anchored on `ENCOUNTER` and one qualified `CLINICAL_EVENT` treatment result per event, joining `PERSON`/`PRSNL` by supported Cerner keys; resolve PT/OT/SLP, direct/group/concurrent, and event-status meanings through governed Code Sets rather than hard-coded display text.  
Mandatory guardrails are read-only execution, tenant and authorized date-range predicates, minimum-necessary PHI, explicit event-type/status filters, effective-dated code-set validation, null/duplicate and end-before-start checks, prevention of Cartesian joins, and DA2/BIRT row, timeout, and audit controls.
traces.cssrs_adult_completed_responses_da2_quer: In Discern Analytics 2.0 (CWC Encounter domain, Logical View UUID 690ff3c7-f0b2-4019-8176-4e26eeff14f0), multi-question Interactive View (IView) clinical assessments such as the Adult C-SSRS must follow five live-verified invariants: (1) Set owner_group_display='TENANT_OWNER_GROUP' on <queries> in .daquery and <report> in .dareport .rpt to prevent ReportXMLException: The owner group [] does not exist; (2) Escape all XML entities (&, <, >) inside BIRT 4.4.2 .rptdesign <property> and <text-property> tags to prevent SAXParseException INVALID_XML; (3) Reference inline subquery columns in Query1 <output> and <qualification> via joinParent='<SubqueryName>' (never query='<SubqueryName>') and restrict joinType='3' mode='1' (+) outer joins to a single base table in Query1 so Oracle never raises ORA-01416 (two tables cannot be outer-joined to each other); (4) Push the indexed Enc Registration Dt/Tm <runtimeprompt> (mode='4', UUID 42ee9a32-031f-495d-962a-5f04376e071a) into Query1 and every inline_ind='1' subquery with usegroupby='0' useorderby='0' to prevent full-table scans on V500.CLINICAL_EVENT and query timeouts; (5) Join Query1 to each inline subquery (WishD, LevelRisk, SBehavior, SMethod, SPlan, SIntent) on Enc Id (5ef4381c-6344-43c4-81b5-2c18cd6bcb70) with 3-column deduplicated subquery output (Enc Id, CE Event, CE Result Value) rather than CE Parent Event Id (8c750217-756f-4276-8888-17d7cc0408ae), because IView C-SSRS DTAs are self-parented (CLINICAL_EVENT.PARENT_EVENT_ID = CLINICAL_EVENT.EVENT_ID) and joining on CE Parent Event Id leaves all joined response columns NULL.
